basic_details.job_title: IRCS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Deputy Secretary, Under Secretary Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Red Cross Society (IRCS), National Headquarters, New Delhi, is engaging retired Government officers for 3 posts on a short-term basis: 1 Deputy Secretary and 2 Under Secretary. Applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) must be addressed to the Secretary General, Indian Red Cross Society, National Headquarters, 1, Red Cross Road, New Delhi-110001, and must reach the office by 4 December 2026. The Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT) has circulated the vacancy to retired CSS officers through its website.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for engagement is 62 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. This limit applies to both posts.

qualification.details: Retired Group 'A' officers of the Central Government, including officers of the Central Secretariat Service/Other Group A services, who have served at the level of Deputy Secretary or Director, or in an equivalent capacity at level 12/13 of 7th CPC. Preference may be given to officers having relevant experience in administrative, Finance, and coordination of Meetings, etc. | One post is for Account/Finance related work such as audit, accounts, budget, cash etc., and one post is for General Administration/Establishment/Meetings. Retired officers of the Organised Accounts Services such as Cost Accounts, Audit Accounts, Defence Accounts, Civil Accounts, Indian Railway Accounts Service, Indian Postal and Telecommunication Finance Service. | The officers should have substantial experience in administrative matters, interpretation and application of Central Government rules and regulations, matters relating to autonomous/statutory bodies, finance and establishment, coordination of meetings and Annual General Meetings, court cases, Right to Information matters, inter-departmental coordination, noting and drafting, and other related administrative functions. | Good managerial and interpersonal skills Sound noting and drafting abilities Effective communication skills Ability to liaise with Ministries, Government Departments, autonomous/statutory bodies and other organisations Computer knowledge and the ability to operate independently | The maximum age limit for engagement is 62 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. This limit applies to both posts. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks applicants to state their educational qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete service-wise eligibility of each post. | The remuneration shall be regulated in accordance with the applicable Department of Expenditure/Government of India instructions governing the engagement of retired Government officers. The remuneration may be fixed at 50% of the last pay drawn, along with Transport Allowance at the time of retirement, as admissible as per decision of the IRCS competent authority. The notice prints no fixed amount.

important_instructions: The engagement shall initially be for a short-term period of one year, subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the Indian Red Cross Society. Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date are liable to be rejected. For any further clarification, the DoPT Office Memorandum asks applicants to contact the concerned Ministry/Department/Office directly. IRCS contact details printed on the circular: Telefax 91-11-23717454; Phones (PBX Lines) 23716441, 42, 43; Email [email protected]; Website www.indianredcross.org.

content_sections.heading: About IRCS
content_sections.text: The Indian Red Cross Society was established under the Indian Red Cross Society Act, 1920 (Act XV of 1920). It is a statutory humanitarian organisation that functions as an auxiliary to the Government and the Armed Forces Medical Services, and it contributes to saving lives, protecting livelihoods and providing relief during disasters and other emergencies. The President of India is the President of the Society, and the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare is its Chairman; its headquarters is at 1, Red Cross Road, New Delhi-110001.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed proforma attached to the circular as Annexure-I and addressed to: The Secretary General, Indian Red Cross Society, National Headquarters, 1, Red Cross Road, New Delhi-110001 The application should reach this office by 4 December 2026. Incomplete applications or applications received after the prescribed closing date are liable to be rejected. The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post or registered post) or any line to be written on the envelope. Name of the applicant Date of birth Date of retirement Last post held and pay level Service/cadre Last pay drawn Copy of PPO, if applicable Educational qualifications Details of relevant experience in General Administration, finance, establishment, court cases, Meetings, Coordination etc. Address for communication Mobile number and email address The form ends with the applicant's signature and the date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Retired Group 'A' officers of the Central Government, including officers of the Central Secretariat Service/Other Group A services, who have served at the level of Deputy Secretary or Director, or in an equivalent capacity at level 12/13 of 7th CPC. Preference may be given to officers having relevant experience in administrative, Finance, and coordination of Meetings, etc. One post is for Account/Finance related work such as audit, accounts, budget, cash etc., and one post is for General Administration/Establishment/Meetings. Retired officers of the Organised Accounts Services such as Cost Accounts, Audit Accounts, Defence Accounts, Civil Accounts, Indian Railway Accounts Service, Indian Postal and Telecommunication Finance Service. The officers should have substantial experience in administrative matters, interpretation and application of Central Government rules and regulations, matters relating to autonomous/statutory bodies, finance and establishment, coordination of meetings and Annual General Meetings, court cases, Right to Information matters, inter-departmental coordination, noting and drafting, and other related administrative functions. Good managerial and interpersonal skills Sound noting and drafting abilities Effective communication skills Ability to liaise with Ministries, Government Departments, autonomous/statutory bodies and other organisations Computer knowledge and the ability to operate independently The maximum age limit for engagement is 62 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. This limit applies to both posts. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks applicants to state their educational qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete service-wise eligibility of each post. The remuneration shall be regulated in accordance with the applicable Department of Expenditure/Government of India instructions governing the engagement of retired Government officers. The remuneration may be fixed at 50% of the last pay drawn, along with Transport Allowance at the time of retirement, as admissible as per decision of the IRCS competent authority. The notice prints no fixed amount.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IRCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 Deputy Secretary and 2 Under Secretary at the Indian Red Cross Society, National Headquarters, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for IRCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Secretary General, Indian Red Cross Society, National Headquarters, New Delhi, by 4 December 2026; late applications are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the IRCS Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: Retired Group 'A' officers of the Central Government, including CSS/Other Group A services, who served as Deputy Secretary or Director, or in an equivalent capacity at level 12/13 of 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for the IRCS Under Secretary posts?
faq.answer: Retired officers of the Organised Accounts Services such as Cost Accounts, Audit Accounts, Defence Accounts, Civil Accounts, Indian Railway Accounts Service and Indian Postal and Telecommunication Finance Service; one post is for Account/Finance work and one for General Administration/Establishment/Meetings.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IRCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for engagement is 62 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. How will the pay of retired officers be fixed in IRCS?
faq.answer: The remuneration may be fixed at 50% of the last pay drawn, along with Transport Allowance at the time of retirement, as admissible as per decision of the IRCS competent authority, under Department of Expenditure/Government of India instructions.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for IRCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I proforma and send it to The Secretary General, Indian Red Cross Society, National Headquarters, 1, Red Cross Road, New Delhi-110001, so that it reaches by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IRCS engagement permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on a short-term basis, initially for one year, subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the Indian Red Cross Society.
